origin.description: Implicit midpoint rule on an equispaced grid. A scalar stage is solved with fzero, and a system with Broyden.
origin.usage: midpoint(f, t0, tfinal, y0, tol = 1e-08, kmax = 101, ...)

arguments.name: y0
arguments.text: Initial value, a row or column vector.

arguments.name: tol
arguments.text: Present in the signature; the implicit grid does not use it.
